text: A 30 day pilot focused on student records, marks, results, attendance, and controlled school access
One connected workspace for routine school operations
Nexatech helps a school capture information once, keep it under controlled access, and retrieve it when staff or families need it.
Registers, marks, results, invoices, and school records stay in one system.
Role based access separates administration, teaching, finance, and parent views.
Validation, audit history, backups, and managed hosting protect the school record.
The school can begin with academics and extend into the wider platform
Searchable learner records, class placement, guardians, and account status.
Assessments, grading, marks entry, rankings, report cards, and exports.
Attendance, finance, timetables, communications, behaviour, and parent access.
Each user sees the records and actions assigned to their role.
The first flagship workflow for the school pilot
1  Select the class, subject, term, and assessment
3  Enter or update marks in one grid
4  Save the set and retrieve results immediately
A teacher should complete a 40 learner assessment in under five minutes.
The stored record becomes immediately useful to staff
Authorized staff can retrieve rankings and averages by class, term, and year.
Teachers can open the correct roster and record status with optional remarks.
One view combines academic outcomes with the wider learner record
Subject percentages, grades, remarks, positions, and overall average.
Attendance, behaviour standing, and fee status appear beside the results.
Authorized staff preview the report and download a PDF for approved use.
Capture methods can match the records a school already has

Keyboard entry and spreadsheet column paste

Roster based marks capture with validation and autosave

Bulk grade API with duplicate safe updates

CSV or spreadsheet upload for learners, guardians, classes, and marks

Column mapping, row validation, error file, and approval before import

Reusable intake templates for each school

OCR assisted capture from scanned forms or photographed mark sheets

Human review of extracted fields before anything reaches the school record

Quoted as custom work after sample documents are tested
Every import should stage data first, explain rejected rows, and require confirmation before committing records.
Authorized people can reach the records they need from any connected device
The school controls access by role, school context, and assigned responsibility.
The browser based workspace supports office, classroom, and parent access without sharing one common account.
Access controls remain part of the pilot test, including tenant separation, role permissions, session security, and audit history.
School setup, learners, users, reports, finance, communications, and configuration.
Assigned classes, attendance, assessments, marks, results, and approved notices.
Read only access to the linked child, reports, fees, timetable, and announcements.
Invoices, payments, cashbook, approved expenses, and finance reports.
Notices can reach the correct audience through approved channels

SMS and email broadcasts
Audience selection by school role or grade
Reusable templates and scheduled messages
Delivery logs, failures, and retry visibility
Exam reminders, sports fixtures, transport changes, meeting notices, payment updates, and urgent alerts.
WhatsApp Business can be added as a managed connector after provider approval, templates, consent rules, and costs are agreed.
An internal news space can grow into a controlled public information channel
Staff publish notices for the whole school, parents, teachers, staff, or a selected grade. Each item can publish immediately, follow a schedule, or expire automatically.
A school approved public page can share sports results, event updates, achievements, calendars, notices, and selected documents. Private learner information stays inside authenticated views.
Draft shown with synthetic demonstration content and not published.
The pilot fixes the first workflow while preserving room for later modules
Named responsibilities, approval rights, parent visibility, and module access.
Terms, subjects, grading bands, assessment weights, report layouts, and class structures.
Import templates, required fields, validation rules, archive mapping, and optional OCR review.
Sender identity, templates, audiences, schedules, SMS and email providers, then WhatsApp if approved.
Branding, domain, parent portal, internal news, and an optional public updates page.
Managed API access, payments, exports, and approved connections to existing services.
The implementation plan should enable modules in phases, with a price, owner, test, and acceptance condition for each phase.
A controlled evaluation using agreed data and named users
Confirm scope, clean one data file, configure users and academic settings.
Train the administrator and teachers on the agreed workflows.
Run student records, marks, results, and attendance with support.
Measure time saved, corrections, adoption, and the next rollout decision.
Up to 500 active learners, one administrator, up to 10 teachers, and synthetic or school approved data only.
If the school signs the Academic or Operations plan within 14 days of the pilot review, apply the US$299 pilot fee toward the standard US$350 onboarding charge.
SMS, email, payment provider fees, dedicated database resources, complex data cleaning, taxes, and custom integrations remain separate.
React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 4, Axios, Laravel 13, PHP 8.4, Sanctum, DOMPDF, and Paynow SDK
Managed MySQL, Redis queues and cache, encrypted sessions, backups, scheduler, worker, logs, and health checks
Docker deployment on Railway with separate web, worker, scheduler, MySQL, and Redis services behind HTTPS
Agree the pilot scope, nominate the school lead, approve the data set, and schedule the demonstration.
